stories.title: Serialize shared writes
stories.summary: The write path now guards shared state while keeping input preparation outside the critical section.

decisions.summary: Keep the guard around state mutation.
decisions.rationale: The shared write must be serialized; preparation does not access the shared state.
decisions.inspect: Check each write entry point and the concurrent-call case.

impact.summary: Calls reaching the shared writer run one at a time.
Concurrent batches may wait longer for the guarded write.
